The statement is a declaration that the lines after it read (signedBy), so no prefix if, guard or if/else can skip it without moving it out of scope. Its text stays verbatim in a thunk handed to StealthSignatureLookupUnlessOwn, which calls it for every other module; for an own binary the answer is null, as the lookup would have returned after its search. Our function reads the version resource itself; the second read of the same file is invisible to a page.
